subject.title: Control UI sidebar IA cleanup: demote Activity to Settings, fold Dreams into Agents, single MCP mutation owner

question: Should Control UI adopt this hierarchy and make Plugins the sole guided owner of MCP-server mutations, including removal of the standalone Dreams route without a redirect?
rationale: Navigation hierarchy, deep-link removal, and the permanent Settings-versus-Plugins ownership boundary are product choices rather than repairs to an established broken contract.

options.title: Adopt proposed hierarchy
options.body: Move Activity under Settings, fold Dreams into Agents, centralize guided MCP mutations in Plugins, and give Usage a distinct icon.

options.title: Split the decision
options.body: Approve the icon and navigation cleanup now but retain the current Dreams route and MCP toggle until separate UX review.

options.title: Keep current surfaces
options.body: Retain the existing routes and both MCP interaction paths and close the proposal as not planned.

recommendation.title: Adopt proposed hierarchy
recommendation.body: Move Activity under Settings, fold Dreams into Agents, centralize guided MCP mutations in Plugins, and give Usage a distinct icon.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of sidebar information architecture, Settings, Plugins, Agents, and per-agent memory direction.
